svg.title: The local AI checking an image: hits and misses
svg.desc: Left: a fake photo I made with an AI image model (FLUX.2). Problems the local AI (Qwen3.6 35B) caught in one pass: 1 a Canadian flag with a malformed maple leaf, 2 a car on bare rock with no road, 3 uneven dock posts.
svg.text: The 35B caught all three flaws in one pass (7 images in 19 s)
malformed maple leaf on the flag
a car on bare rock, no road
The photo is not a real place; it was generated with FLUX.2. About 2.7 s per image with the 35B.
